findings.description: The Lambda function's environment variables contain a literal AWS access key ID (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE) and secret access key, which are stored in Terraform state and visible in the console/API to anyone with read access to the function configuration. These long-lived static credentials should be replaced with an IAM execution role or Secrets Manager/SSM references.
The function runs on the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving known vulnerabilities in the runtime and its bundled dependencies unpatched.
